brief:
Sheikh Ali al-Youssef, head of the Jerusalem section at the Palestinian Scholars Association, characterized settler incursions into Al-Aqsa Mosque during the Jewish holiday known as Shavuot as systematic criminality aimed at altering the mosque's character, Shehab Wire reported. He described the ongoing violations and raids as part of a deliberate, long-term campaign to Judaize the holy site.

Al-Youssef framed the recent intrusions as the latest episode in what he called an organized effort to transform Al-Aqsa's identity through sustained settler actions timed to religious holidays.
